title: Super Supportive · Episode 20 · 三十只新朋友
description: Alden brings a meal he is certain will work. Gorgon finds a different use for it.

planning.storytellingVoice: Warm, self-questioning adolescent: canonical overconfidence, bafflement and affectionate determination suit personable first-person Mandarin; humour aimed at Alden’s assumptions.
planning.desire: Find food his friend can eat.
planning.obstacle: Even live crickets fail; Gorgon cannot explain the restrictions.
planning.earlyCare: Alden lightly insists on friendship rather than formal distance.
planning.payoff: Gorgon smiles and gives the crickets homes among the lobby plants; the gift matters although it was not eaten.
planning.continuingQuestion: What can Gorgon actually eat, and why is Alden so determined to solve this?
planning.direction: Comic panels with six images per sheet, held alongside text. Vary wide/detail/reverse/close/imagined insert; exaggerate Alden’s confidence and confusion gently. Gorgon stays restrained except for the source-supported private smile. Preserve current three encounters and native interlinear/audio.

signatures.Alden: Earnest teenage problem-solver; teasing eyebrow, deliberate wink, then baffled self-correction.
signatures.Gorgon: Dry cricket question, neutral speech, one surprisingly human private smile.

continuation.end: Alden playfully insists on friendship. His thirty live crickets go uneaten, but Gorgon privately smiles and releases them into the lobby plants. Weeks later they still chirp; Alden continues bringing one vegetarian and one meat dish without success. The butcher-shop discussion has not begun.
